europe_now.title: France Extends Protests Restrictions and Curfews
europe_now.summary: French authorities implemented nightly curfews in areas of Paris and total bans on demonstrations in cities including Marseille and Lyon following recent violent unrest. President Emmanuel Macron engaged with student representatives and law enforcement ahead of further anticipated protests.

sources.headline: 🔴Live: Macron meets with student representatives and law enforcement ahead of new protests
Paris extends curfew as Marseille and Lyon ban protests after riots

europe_now.title: Transport Disruptions and Trucker Blockades in Southern Italy
europe_now.summary: Protests and blockades by truck drivers in southern Italy have caused significant economic strain and supply chain disruptions, notably halting buffalo mozzarella production and costing regional producers millions of euros while increasing political pressure on the government.

sources.headline: Italy's trucker protests halt buffalo mozzarella production, cost producers €3m
